salary_details.details: House Rent Allowance (HRA) is applicable as per rules.

selection_process: Candidates meeting essential qualifications will be interviewed through a walk-in interview.
how_to_apply: Download the application format provided in the official notification PDF (Annexure-I & II).
Fill out the complete bio-data in the prescribed proforma.
Compile two copies of the filled application form, two passport-size photographs, and one set of self-attested photocopies of certificates, mark-sheets, and experience proof.
Bring all original documents at the time of the interview for verification.
Report for the walk-in interview on 16 November 2026 at 9:30 AM at the Division of Food Science and Postharvest Technology, NRL Building 3rd floor, ICAR-IARI, New Delhi-110012.
important_instructions: Candidates reporting after 10:30 AM will not be considered for interview. Only candidates meeting essential qualifications would be interviewed. The posts are purely temporary, contractual, non-regular, time-bound, and co-terminus with the project. Selected candidates shall not claim regular appointment at the institute. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates whose near or distant relative is an employee of ICAR/IARI must declare it in advance. Canvassing in any form would lead to disqualification.
